name: Carrion Grub
oracle_text:
This creature gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in your graveyard.
When this creature enters, mill four cards. (Put the top four cards of your library into your graveyard.)
blocked_sentences: This creature gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in your graveyard.

needs.what: a static value leaf reading the greatest printed power among cards matched by a static counting filter in a non-battlefield zone (here: creature cards in your graveyard), so a self-only buff can be sized by it; an empty pool is 0
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The static `extreme_value` leaf (Dragon Man) has the right shape -- objects with zone: graveyard, pick: greatest -- but `_validate_static_extreme_value` in cards/loader/statics.py refuses any `of` other than mana_value, because battlefield power is a layer output. A graveyard card's power is its printed power and is a pipeline input, so the leaf could accept `of: power` when every branch's zone is off the battlefield. `power_of` and the effect-side `extreme_value` are not static value keys, and a self_enters pump would go stale as the graveyard changes
